Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint

Class PaintIO

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.paint.PaintIO
public final class PaintIO extends Object
File I/O for the Paint app: Open / Save / Save-As through a JFileChooser backed by ImageIO for PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP.

JPEG has no alpha channel, so a save to .jpg/.jpeg flattens the image onto white first. Loading reads whatever ImageIO supports and the caller flattens the result into a single background layer (see PaintDocument.fromImage(java.awt.image.BufferedImage)). Save ensures the chosen file carries an extension matching the selected format so ImageIO can find a writer.

  • Method Details

    • chooseAndRead

      public static BufferedImage chooseAndRead(Component parent)
      Shows an Open dialog and reads the chosen image. Returns null if the user cancelled or the file could not be decoded (an IOException is reported by returning null; the caller shows the message from lastError()).

    • chooseAndWrite

      public static File chooseAndWrite(Component parent, BufferedImage image, String suggestedName)
      Shows a Save dialog and writes image to the chosen file, picking the format from the selected filter / extension and flattening onto white for JPEG. Returns the written file, or null if the user cancelled or the write failed.
